vaulttecmediaoptimizer-desc: Losslessly optimizes images and generates WebP versions served to compatible browsers. Reduces bandwidth and improves Core Web Vitals. Distributed by the Vault-Tec Archives.
right-vaulttecmediaoptimizer-admin: Administer Vault-Tec Media Optimizer (run backfill, view stats)
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-intro: This page checks that the environment meets the extension's prerequisites. Run these checks before and after install, and whenever something seems off.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-no-failure: No blocking issues detected. The extension can function.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-has-failur: $1 blocking issue(s) detected. Fix these before enabling backfill.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-status-has-warnin: $1 warning(s). The extension will work but some features may be limited.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-intro: Optimizes the wiki's existing images. Processing happens in the background via MediaWiki's job queue, without blocking the site.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-schedule: Queue every remaining eligible file at once. On wikis with many images this may take a few seconds.
$1 files scheduled. They will be processed automatically as web requests come in — this page auto-refreshes every 10 seconds.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-queue-in: $1 jobs queued. They will be processed automatically as web requests come in.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-reset-do: $1 file(s) reset to pending. They will be retried in the next batch.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-e: Losslessly recompress original PNGs with the configured engine ($1) to save disk space. Does not affect quality or the WebP versions served to visitors.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-i: $1 files scheduled for PNG recompression. Processing runs in the background.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-zopfli-n: No PNG files to recompress at the moment.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-rate-hin: To speed up processing, temporarily increase $wgJobRunRate in LocalSettings.php, or ask your hosting provider to set up a cron running runJobs.php.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-backfill-no-eligi: No files currently eligible for optimization.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-intro: Summary of gains since extension activation.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-no-data: No data available. Run the backfill to start.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-imagick-missi: Imagick is not installed. The extension will fall back to GD. Ask your hosting provider to install php-imagick.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-imagick-no-we: Imagick is installed but without WebP support. Ask your hosting provider to install libwebp and recompile Imagick.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-gd-no-webp: GD is installed without WebP support. If Imagick is also missing, the extension cannot generate WebP.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-webp-dir-miss: WebP directory $1 does not exist. It will be created on first processing if permissions allow.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-webp-dir-not-: WebP directory $1 is not writable by the web server. Check permissions (recommended: 755 or 775, owner = web server user).
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-table-missing: Table vtmo_image_optimization does not exist. Run MediaWiki's update.php script, or ask your hosting provider.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-multimediavie: MultimediaViewer detected. The extension is designed to remain compatible (the stays accessible inside ). Verify after installation that images still open in full screen.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-memory-low: PHP memory limit is $1. To process large images, 256M minimum is recommended.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-disk-low: Less than 1 GB available on upload partition. WebP storage requires about 30% additional space.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-filebackend-r: This wiki uses a remote file backend (Swift, S3, etc.). This extension requires local filesystem storage (FSFileBackend) because it manipulates files directly on disk. Processing will fail with this backend.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-msg-fatal-no-webp: No backend supports WebP. The extension is unusable. Install Imagick with WebP support.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-space-saved: Total space saved (from upload to final file)
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-note-n: On disk, the extension uses more space than it frees: the generated WebP files (one per image, in addition to the original) weigh more than what is saved by optimizing the originals. This is normal and expected — the extension's benefit is reduced bandwidth served to visitors, not disk space. Thumbnail WebP files, not counted here, further increase the WebP space used.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-disk-note-p: On disk, optimizing the originals offsets the space used by the generated WebP files. Note: thumbnail WebP files are not counted in this balance.
vaulttecmediaoptimizer-stats-bw-note: Illustrative estimate based on the average WebP reduction ratio observed on this wiki, applied to a representative page. Real pages serve thumbnails; the saving percentage applies regardless of their size, while the absolute volume depends on the number and size of images shown. The extension does not measure actual page views.
